title: A Machine Learning API for Earth Observation Data Cubes Based on openEO
abstract: arXiv:2609.13453v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Earth Observation (EO) data are increasingly organized as spatio-temporal data cubes, while machine learning (ML) methods operate on tabular feature matrices or structured tensor inputs. This mismatch forces platform-specific transformations that are difficult to reproduce or transfer across cloud infrastructures. The openEO specification provides a unified interface for EO data access and processing across heterogeneous backends, but lacks a standardized approach for ML integration.   We propose a process-level ML specification for openEO structured into three stages: model initialization, model actions (training, tuning, inference, validation), and model management. It supports classical algorithms such as Random Forest and SVM, as well as deep learning architectures for time-series and spatial patch-based modeling, including TempCNN, Temporal Attention Encoders, and foundation model inference. translated_title: 基于 openEO 的地球观测数据立方体机器学习 API
translated_abstract: 地球观测（EO）数据越来越多地以时空数据立方体的形式组织，而机器学习（ML）方法则在表格化的特征矩阵或结构化张量输入上进行操作。这种不匹配迫使平台进行特定的转换，这些转换难以在不同云基础设施之间重现或迁移。openEO 规范为跨异构后端的地球观测数据访问与处理提供了统一接口，但缺乏标准化的机器学习集成方法。我们提出了一种面向 openEO 的流程级机器学习规范，其结构分为三个阶段：模型初始化、模型操作（训练、调优、推理、验证）和模型管理。该规范既支持经典算法（如随机森林和支持向量机），也支持面向时间序列和空间图像块建模的深度学习架构，包括 TempCNN、时间注意力编码器以及基础模型推理。三个原型实现分别基于 R 和……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于 openEO 的流程级机器学习规范，通过模型初始化、模型操作和模型管理三个阶段，为地球观测数据立方体提供标准化的机器学习集成接口，支持从随机森林等经典算法到深度学习和基础模型的多种方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a process-level machine learning specification for openEO, structured into model initialization, model actions, and model management stages, providing a standardized interface for integrating machine learning methods—from classical algorithms to deep learning architectures and foundation models—with Earth Observation data cubes.
